The project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), as set in config/paths.yaml.
OUTPUTS ------- str Absolute path, ending in '/' (scripts append to it, e.g. stem + "data/").

Initialize logging with a file + console handler and pipe basic metadata.
INPUTS ---------- log_dir : str Directory where the log file should be written. log_file_name : str Full path to the output log file. now : datetime.datetime, optional Timestamp used for the "created at" log line. If None, that line is skipped.
OUTPUTS ------- None Configures the root logger and writes startup log lines.

Load a YAML configuration file and pipe its contents to the log.
INPUTS ---------- config_file_choice : str Path to the configuration file. print_one_line : bool, optional If True, log the entire config on a single line. If False (default), log in a more readable, multiline format.
OUTPUTS ------- config_this : dict The configuration dictionary loaded from file.

a.xlink:title:
Load the common observing config, then merge each test-specific config on top, in order (top-level keys of later files override earlier ones).
INPUTS ---------- stem : str Project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), prepended to relative paths. *test_config_files : str Test-specific observing configs, relative to stem or absolute.
OUTPUTS ------- dict The merged observing config.

Load image data and header metadata from a selected FITS HDU.
Uses ``memmap=False``. If the path is on a flaky Podman/macOS share and open raises errno 35 (Resource deadlock avoided), copies the file to ``/tmp`` (with ``cp``, ``dd`` or ``cat``) and opens that instead.
If ``hdu_index`` is past the end of the file, not an EXTNAME in the file, or that HDU has no array data, falls back to the first HDU that contains a usable image array (usually the primary HDU at index 0 for single-extension FITS files).
INPUTS ---------- file_name : str Abs path to the FITS file containing the PSF-grid data. hdu_index : int or str, optional Preferred HDU: an index, or an EXTNAME. The SIM writers (modules/sim_common.py and the IMG-OPT-02 SIM) write BCKGD_SUBTED, RAW_READOUT, BACKGROUND (+ extras) after a header-only primary, so BCKGD_SUBTED is extension 1 and RAW_READOUT extension 2; some earlier SIM files had RAW_READOUT first. Prefer the EXTNAME. Simpler FITS may only have HDU 0.
OUTPUTS ------- tuple[np.ndarray, Any] Tuple containing a copy of the HDU data as a NumPy array and a copy of the HDU header.
a.text: metadata from a selected FITS HDU.

Mask the real PSF, so we can find the stray light.
The mask is everything within psf_mask_n_lambda_over_d * lambda/D of the PSF centroid, with psf_mask_n_lambda_over_d set in the observing config.
INPUTS: - result_obj (StrayLightResult): result object - observing_config (ObservingConfig): observing config
OUTPUTS: - result_obj, with real_psf_mask set

a.xlink:title:
Segment the stray light with a weighted combination of the methods in SEGMENTATION_METHODS.
Each method with weight > 0 is run on the same denoised frame. Regions that overlap across methods get the same label (see _combine_method_regions). A pixel is finally counted as stray light if Σ' > N * Σ, where Σ' is the summed weight of the methods detecting that pixel, Σ is the sum of all weights, and N = vote_fraction.
INPUTS: - result_obj: result object (needs image and real_psf_mask) - weights: {method: weight in [0, 1]}; methods left out get weight 1, weight 0 skips a method. If None, uses result_obj.segmentation_weights (e.g. from the data state), else all 1. - vote_fraction: N in [0, 1]. If None, uses result_obj.segmentation_vote_fraction, else SEGMENTATION_DEFAULT_VOTE_FRACTION - params: {method: {knob: value}} overriding SEGMENTATION_DEFAULT_PARAMS[method]; if None, uses result_obj.segmentation_params if set
OUTPUTS: - result_obj (StrayLightResult), updated attributes: - segment_map (np.ndarray[int32]): group labels of the final regions (0 = not stray light) - segmentation_method (str): 'combined' - segmentation_weights, segmentation_vote_fraction: as used - method_label_maps (dict): per method, group labels of its detections - final_label_map (np.ndarray): group labels of the final regions (same as segment_map) - FYI plots and FITS file in the result object's results_dir (stray_light_segmentation_*_<stem>.png, stray_light_segmentation_combined_<stem> .png/.fits)

a.xlink:title:
Segment the stray light.
Ideas and methods herein are from Eric Pantin's notebook for instructional purposes (dev_notebooks/TP_image_segmentation.ipynb). Many knobs remain to be tuned with real data.
INPUTS: - result_obj: result object (needs image and real_psf_mask) - method: segmentation method; one of SEGMENTATION_METHODS: - 'threshold': global threshold (otsu/mean/median) of the denoised image, then connected components - 'hough_circle': circles fitted to bright blobs; each region is a filled circle - 'active_contour': as 'hough_circle', but each circle is refined with an active contour (snake) and dilated by expand_px - 'watershed': thresholded foreground split into touching blobs by distance-transform seeds + watershed - 'kmeans': k-means clustering of pixel intensities; the brightest cluster(s) are stray light - 'meanshift': mean-shift filtering, then an Otsu threshold of the filtered image If None, uses result_obj.segmentation_method (e.g. from the data state), else 'active_contour'. - params: dict overriding SEGMENTATION_DEFAULT_PARAMS[method]; if None, uses result_obj.segmentation_params if set
OUTPUTS: - result_obj (StrayLightResult), updated attributes: - segment_map (np.ndarray[int32]): integer region labels (0 = not stray light), regions labelled 1..n - segmentation_method (str): the method used - FYI plot in the result object's results_dir

Measure the attenuation of out-of-field irradiance (METIS-5838).
The attenuation is the ratio of the peak irradiance of the source (the PSF peak) to the peak scattered irradiance on the detector. The scattered irradiance is measured on a box-car smoothed version of the background-subtracted image (to beat down the pixel noise), excluding everything within n_lambda_over_d_exclusion * lambda/D of the PSF so that the PSF wings are not mistaken for scattered light.
The scattered light only counts as detected if its peak exceeds detection_nsigma times the noise of the smoothed map. That noise is measured from the null frame (difference of two independent background frames, smoothed the same way), so that correlated noise is included. If nothing is detected, the attenuation is a lower limit (see _attenuation_verdict).
N.b. in the real test the source is outside the FOV and the PSF peak comes from a separate in-field reference exposure; in the simulated data the PSF is in the frame.
INPUTS: - result_obj (OutOfFieldResult): result object, with centroids, real_psf_mask and (preferably) null_image - observing_config (dict): observing config, incl. the 'metis_5838' block
OUTPUTS: - result_obj (OutOfFieldResult), updated attributes: - psf_peak, stray_peak_irradiance, stray_mean_irradiance, stray_irradiance_noise, detection_threshold, attenuation_measured, attenuation_is_lower_limit, attenuation_req, verdict_metis_5838

Measure the segmented stray light regions for METIS-9522, as for IMG-OPT-04: each region's total flux and its limit, 3-sigma of the background noise of the summed flux over the same area (i.e. for the spatial scale of the region). Pass/fail is decided in log_test_outcome; the point/extended-source sensitivities are plotted FYI only.
INPUTS: - result_obj (OutOfFieldResult): result object, with real_psf_mask and segment_map (integer label map of the stray light regions) - observing_config (dict): observing config
OUTPUTS: - result_obj (OutOfFieldResult), updated attributes: - regions (with metis_9522_limit set), background_rms

Decide and log the pass/fail of each IMG-OPT-06 requirement, and of the whole test.
- METIS-5838: the verdict from metis_5838_attenuation (PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE). - METIS-9522: the total flux of every stray light region is below 3-sigma of the background noise of the summed flux over its area (StrayLightRegion .metis_9522_limit, from metis_9522_check); no regions: PASS. Overall: PASS only if both pass; INCONCLUSIVE if METIS-5838 is inconclusive and METIS-9522 passes; else FAIL. If the data are simulated, also checks the METIS-5838 outcome against the injected truth.
OUTPUTS: - result_obj (OutOfFieldResult), with pass_metis_9522 and verdict_overall set

a.xlink:title:
Combine the regions found by several segmentation methods.
Bookkeeping: the regions of all methods are OR-ed together, and each connected component (8-connectivity) of that union is one 'group' with one label. So regions from different methods which overlap (or touch) share a label; a group a method did not detect is absent from that method's label map.
Final regions: a pixel is in if the summed weight of the methods detecting it is > vote_fraction * (sum of all weights), and is not in the real PSF. Final regions keep their group label.
INPUTS: - method_region_maps (dict[str, ndarray]): per method, its label map (>0 = in a region) - weights (dict[str, float]): weight per method (all methods, incl. those with weight 0) - vote_fraction (float): N, in [0, 1] - psf_mask (ndarray[bool]): mask of the real PSF
OUTPUTS: - dict with: - group_labels (ndarray[int32]): label of each group (0 = no method detected anything) - method_label_maps (dict[str, ndarray[int32]]): per method, group labels where it detected something - score_map (ndarray[float]): summed weight of the methods detecting each pixel - sigma (float): sum of all weights - threshold (float): vote_fraction * sigma - final_label_map (ndarray[int32]): group labels of the pixels passing the weighted vote - final_labels (list[int]): group labels with at least one final pixel
FYI plot: image with each method's regions outlined in its own colour, the final (weighted-vote) regions with a bold border, and each group's label; saved to plot_file_name.
a.text: FYI plot: image with each method's

a.xlink:title: Write the combined segmentation to a FITS file of boolean maps (uint8: 1 = stray light region, 0 = not): - PRIMARY: header only (input file, weights, vote fraction, threshold) - one extension per method that was run (EXTNAME = method): regions it detected - FINAL: regions from the weighted vote The real PSF is always 0. Cross-method group labels are listed in each extension's LABELS keyword (and annotated in the combined FYI plot).
a.text: a FITS file of boolean maps

a.xlink:title: 2D array of distances (pixels) from the PSF centroid.

METIS-5838 verdict from the peak scattered irradiance and the detection threshold.
- Scattered light detected (stray_peak > threshold): attenuation = psf_peak / stray_peak; PASS if >= attenuation_req, else FAIL. - Not detected: the attenuation is only known to be > psf_peak / threshold; PASS if that lower limit >= attenuation_req, else INCONCLUSIVE (data not deep enough to show the requirement either way).
OUTPUTS: - attenuation (float): measured attenuation, or its lower limit - is_lower_limit (bool) - verdict (str): 'PASS', 'FAIL' or 'INCONCLUSIVE'
